correctness.rationale: Proof reduces satisfaction to nondecreasing binary words; inconsistency of fixed literals is equivalent to an inverted pair; minimal disagreement sets with cut words are determined by immediate boundary bits; the satisfied case follows by explicit singleton/boundary flips and hitting-set duality; padding a word by 0 and 1 makes an exact bijection with transition positions. All edge cases n=1 and constant words are included. Direct-completion subset enumeration through length eight checks the finite formulas without using the closed expressions; the proof, not enumeration, handles all n.

value.rationale: Natural temporal safety property: using the same proposition in every weak-next clause couples obligations and produces a sharp linear CXp ceiling, in explicit contrast to exponential independent-clause examples. Full parametric AXp/CXp descriptions for both classes and exact distribution/extrema give a motivated classification and reproducible regression family, rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
